title: Director of Manufacturing Engineering
text:
**Director of Manufacturing – Defense & Space | Confidential**

Los Angeles, Southern California – onsite

Up to $325K base (negotiable) + equity + benefits

I’m running a confidential search for a Director of Manufacturing at one of the fastest growing companies in the industry building hardware for defense and space programs.

They’ve proven the tech. Now they need someone to scale production and build the team that does it. You’ll own manufacturing end to end, from first build through to rate production, reporting directly to the COO.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead and grow the manufacturing team, including manufacturing engineering and production
* Take hardware from development builds to repeatable rate production
* Set up the factory, tooling, processes and systems to scale
* Work closely with design engineering so new products are built to be built
* Own schedule, cost and quality on the production floor
* Help shape where the factory goes next

**What you’ll bring**

* 8+ years in manufacturing, including time leading teams
* Experience scaling hardware production in aerospace, defense or space
* A track record of building teams and processes at an early-stage company
* Comfort in a fast-moving environment where you’re hands-on and strategic in the same week
* An active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one

**Why this one**

* A seat at the table at a company with real momentum
* Ownership of the whole build, not one piece of it
* The chance to build the team your way

The client’s confidential, but there’s plenty more I can share on a call. If this sounds like you, or someone you know, send me a message.
